column1: # guard_allow.tsv: findings the render guard (Tools/render/guard.lua) lets pass, one per line, tab-separated:
# owner scope, scene glob, kind (ellipsis, outside, clipped or overlap), subject (its start, or = and the whole
# subject), reason. The owner is the fix scope that owns the defect (round 3: rank/FIX_R3_SCOPES.md, R1 to R7;
# round 4: rank/FIX_R4_SCOPES.md, S1 to S6); the PR that fixes it deletes its lines. shoot.sh --strict fails on a
# line naming one scene that no longer matches, and a full gallery or class run fails on a glob line that matched
# nothing in any of its scenes. "design" marks a deliberate straddle the guard cannot tell from a spill (a tab or
# a coin set on a card's edge, a stand-in label under a mover plate); it is not a defect.
